title: MonitorMethodDTO
description: MonitorMethodDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

parameterCode.description: Code used to identify the parameter.

monitoringMethodCode.description: Code used to identify the monitoring methodology.

substituteDataCode.description: Code used to identify the substitute data approach type.

bypassApproachCode.description: Code used to identify the value to be used for an unmonitored bypass stack.

beginDate.description: Date on which information became effective or activity started.

beginHour.description: Hour in which information became effective.

endDate.description: Last date in which information was effective.  This date will be null for active records.

endHour.description: Last hour in which information was effective.  This value will be null for active records.

id.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring method record.

locationId.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring location record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.

active.description: Flag for active monitor location record
